named_policies.label: EU confidential
named_policies.description: Keep confidential work EU-scoped with privacy-forward defaults and policy-constrained routing.

named_policies.label: Lowest cost under SLA
named_policies.description: Push toward the cheapest eligible provider while still respecting the 24-hour MVP SLA.

named_policies.label: Agent main thread
named_policies.description: Favor low expected wall-clock time for patient agent loops while keeping cost and 24-hour SLA risk visible.

named_policies.label: ZDR only
named_policies.description: Route only to zero-data-retention providers for the most sensitive restricted workloads.

named_policies.label: Quality-first review
named_policies.description: Favor stronger review quality and resilience on nuanced generation, analysis, and evaluation work.
